1.title: Scope
1.body: These terms are the agreement between you and FixFlow for using the platform as a technician. Work at a specific site is also covered by that site's contract and rules.

2.title: Eligibility and verification
2.body: Keep your platform verification current and complete the site vetting for every site you work on. Only accept work you are qualified and licensed to perform. A suspended or rejected account cannot claim reports, apply for contracts or accept marketplace offers.

3.title: Accepting work
3.body: Claiming a report or accepting a marketplace offer commits you to attend within the site's service window. If you cannot attend, cancel in the app as early as possible so the reporter is not left waiting.

4.title: Safety on site
4.body: Follow the site's rules, report hazards before you start, and stop work that becomes unsafe. Never start a job that requires a licence, permit or equipment you do not hold.

5.title: Evidence and completion
5.body: Keep report status, photos and resolutions accurate. Marking a report resolved declares the work complete; the reporter may confirm it, rate it, or reopen it if the problem persists.

6.title: Payment
6.body: Fees follow the agreement in force for the site where the work is done. Accepting these terms does not guarantee work, income or a contract, and FixFlow does not pay technicians unless a site agreement says otherwise.

7.title: Data and privacy
7.body: Use reporter and site details only for the work assigned to you. Do not copy, forward or store that information outside the platform, and do not photograph people or property beyond what the report requires.

8.title: Suspension and changes
8.body: Verification can be suspended for unsafe work, false submissions, missed attendance or misconduct. When these terms change, a new version is published and you must accept it before taking further work.
